title: Tunisian Vegetable Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired vegetable stew, served over basmati rice. This dish is a perfect blend of Tunisian and Indian spices.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and bell pepper, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add olives, broth, and spice blend. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in ghee or oil. Serve over basmati rice, garnished with parsley.
Cook rice according to package instructions.
Fluff cooked rice with a fork and serve alongside the tagine.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
